style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; brilliant autumn daylight, strong raking sun and crisp deep shadows, glowing sky, rich saturated colour; figures small, unidealised, painted in a few strokes. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: establishing, far. The red-brick gothic asylum at Purfleet on a brilliant autumn afternoon, seen across a wide lawn with clipped yews, a gravel walk and a weathered stone statue; tall windows catch the sun; a young woman in a dark dress walks small along the path.

Shot: wide interior, no faces. A bare whitewashed asylum room on a sunny afternoon, light pouring through a tall barred window in bright bars across the floor; a woman in a dark dress seen small from behind at the door, a man seated on a cot.
